subject: Niko Rell
user_text: I step to the dispatch-box doorway and catch sight of Niko Rell on the loading arcade. I raise an open hand rather than call across the floor. "Niko. Can we talk here a moment? I want to hear what you have to say."

subject: Niko Rell
user_text: "At the shutter you told Ora: west conduit, two turns, then the lift cage. Lose the lane cameras in the condensers." I keep my voice low. "Did that route hold? I am asking you, not writing an answer for you."

subject: Ora Pell
user_text: At the loading arcade I see Ora Pell near the conduit access. I stop short of crowding her and keep my hands in view. "Ora. If you are willing, I would like a word. Here, on your side of the doorway."

subject: Ora Pell
user_text: "At the shutter I caught the chained biscuit tin when you let it go. You told me not to let them make your route into a rescue story." I leave a little space between us. "What do you want me to understand about that now?"

subject: Ivo Senn
user_text: I spot Ivo Senn at the loading-arcade end of the dispatch-box threshold. I keep my voice down and leave the doorway open. "Ivo. Would you be willing to talk here for a moment? You can say no."

subject: Ivo Senn
user_text: "When I tried to make Kessa into Ressa, you said Ressa would not send a courier to be herself. She would come, or tell me why she would not. You were right to stop me." I open my empty hand. "What would actually help with the account waiting at dawn?"
